cards.subject: Stormwind's gold mine
lines: The greatest gold production centre in human lands, reckoned at about a third of the kingdom's reserves.
It was abandoned when the Horde razed Stormwind, and thought haunted after. Then the men who rebuilt the city came back to it as bandits.

cards.subject: The Defias Traitor
lines: You do not find the Deadmines. A captured Defias at Sentinel Hill trades the hideout's location for his life and walks you to Moonbrook himself.
On foot, in the open, at level fifteen.
On contested realms, killing him was a known Horde pastime.

cards.subject: Before the portal
lines: The open stretch of mine outside the instance has its own named enemies, and one of them is a noble who has been brainwashed.
Foreman Thistlenettle is down there with them.
A conspiracy the dungeon never resolves, in a tunnel most groups run straight past.

cards.subject: Rhahk'Zor
lines: The ogre foreman shouts "VanCleef pay big for your heads!"
It is the first thing the dungeon ever says to you, and it tells you who you came for.

cards.subject: Every boss is a door
lines: Through the foundry, each boss is guarding a door. Kill him and it opens — and a patrol respawns behind you.
You are not raiding a mine. You are being let deeper in.

cards.subject: Sneed
cards.tag: In the shredder, and out of it
lines: Kill the machine and he climbs out of the wreck to keep fighting — a two-phase boss before those existed.
Inside it he has hair. Outside it he is bald.
It is a real model quirk, not a joke.

cards.subject: The shipyard
cards.tag: The Mast Room · the Goblin Foundry
lines: Goblins are carving a mast. Gilnid's foundry is casting anchors and cannonballs. The Ironclad Cove has scaffolding, a plank catwalk and a door wide enough to sail a warship out of.
The Defias are building a juggernaut inside a gold mine.
Nobody ever sees it leave.

cards.subject: Mr. Smite
cards.tag: The first mate is a tauren
lines: One of very few tauren bosses anywhere, in a mine no Horde player can quest to.
He swaps weapons twice mid-fight, each swap announced with a War Stomp: a thief's blade, then two reavers, then a hammer.
"You landlubbers are tougher than I thought. I'll have to improvise!"

cards.subject: The cannon
lines: The door to the docks does not open. You loot Defias Gunpowder from an alcove, load the cannon in that room, and blow the gate off.
A rogue can pick the lock instead. The cannon wakes everything behind the door; the lockpick does not.
Most groups never learn the quiet way existed.

cards.subject: Cookie
lines: He is the ship's cook, an optional kill in the galley on the left side of the vessel.
"Captain" Cookie, the cooking pot and the food-throwing fight are all Cataclysm.
Here he is a man with a mace, and you can walk past him.

cards.subject: What he says while dying
lines: He is the only dungeon boss in the game who argues with you as he goes down.
"None may challenge the Brotherhood!" Then: "Lapdogs, all of you!" — "Fools! Our cause is righteous!"
If he wins: "And stay down!"

cards.subject: The Unsent Letter
lines: VanCleef's head goes to Gryan Stoutmantle and the Brotherhood is supposedly finished.
It is not. The letter on his body points back at conspirators still sitting in the House of Nobles.
The dungeon ends with the crime unsolved.
